note: Predeclared before any v0.3 held-out execution. Changing this file after seeing held-out numbers means a new version (v0.4) with a new manifest.
metrics: p99 queue delay (ms), delivered goodput vs real simulated unshaped run, tail-drop fraction, frac steps rate>capacity; spread = min-max
limits: toy fluid single-flow model; held-out families are unseen trace shapes within the same toy model, not real-network generalization
decision_rule: none. No PASS/KILL; results feed a recommendation to the user only.
